# Pair $N$: flags first (run 4), then the gate in the portal (ahw_portal_tmp) and the exit in the
# nearest ring system (ahw_node_tmp), in the node's next free slot.
ahw_spike_make_pair = {
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_entry_$N$
		set_variable = { which = ahw_pair value = $N$ }
	}
	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_exit_$N$
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 60 orbit_angle = 45 }
	}
	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 0 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 1 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 2 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 120 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 3 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 4 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 240 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 5 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 300 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 6 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 7 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 8 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 9 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 210 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 10 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 270 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 11 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 330 }
		}
		else = {
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 150 orbit_angle = 45 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 1 }
	}
	log = "AHW SPIKE pair $N$ built"
}

# The next pair, numbered by the counter ahw_pairs on ring node 1.

		ahw_spike_make_pair = { N = 1 }

		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 2 } } }

# Finds the galaxy's centre: two probe systems leapfrog corewards from the innermost system; the
# better one ends as event_target:ahw_centre_system. No scope.
ahw_spike_find_centre = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	event_target:ahw_inner_tmp = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 20
			max_distance = 20
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_a }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 10
			max_distance = 10
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_t }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	event_target:ahw_probe_t = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		save_global_event_target_as = ahw_centre_system
		log = "AHW SPIKE centre: best probe at distance_to_core_percent \\[This.ahw_d] (0 = the centre)"
	}
}

# Moves the portal (ahw_portal_tmp) around its anchor (ahw_x_tmp) until its arrival in the anchor
# system lies away from the anchor's other lanes (score: see PORTAL_THRESHOLDS in the generator).
ahw_spike_place_portal = {
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { ahw_spike_portal_score = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_score value < 12 } } }
		event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 12 max_distance <= 18 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
			ahw_spike_portal_score = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_score value < 12 } } }
		event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {

			ahw_spike_portal_score = yes
		}

		event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 12 max_distance <= 18 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
			ahw_spike_portal_score = yes
		}

	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		log = "AHW SPIKE portal placed off \\[ahw_x_tmp.GetName]: worst lane margin \\[This.ahw_score] (about +15 = opposite every other lane, 0 = sideways, 1000 = no other lane)"
	}
}
